apps.name: count
apps.about: Pages of tiles for whatever you track. One tap each, with goals, timers, dice, rules and charts.

features.title: Counters and quick steps
features.text: Tap to count, with your own step, goal, limits, units, packs and decimals.

features.title: Display styles
features.text: A number, a bar, a ring, an icon fill or a row of the last seven days.

features.title: Variable amounts
features.text: A tap asks how much. Recent sizes are one tap away.

features.title: Set value
features.text: For a reading, like a weight. The tile shows the change since last time.

features.title: Reset periods and undo
features.text: Reset daily, weekly or monthly. Undo reverts the last action and what its rules did.

features.title: Start over
features.text: Reset a whole page for a game or a new day, in one undo.

features.title: Focus mode
features.text: One counter full screen, a big tap target, screen kept on.

features.title: Pages, tiles and edit mode
features.text: Group tiles on pages. Drag, resize and delete them.

features.title: Icons and colours
features.text: Every counter gets a colour and an optional icon.

features.title: Groups
features.text: Up to 8 counters in one tile, each with its goal bar.

features.title: Example pages
features.text: New installs get three pages that show what it can do.

features.title: Templates
features.text: Start from 13 ready-made pages: Water, Workout, Macros, D&D and more.

features.title: Your own templates
features.text: Save any page as a template on your device.

features.title: Share and import
features.text: Send a page as a link, QR code or file. Only the setup travels, never your counts.

features.title: Phones, foldables, tablets
features.text: Tabs on phones, a rail and side panes on bigger screens.

features.title: Timers
features.text: Stopwatch with laps, countdown with loops and alerts, and time-since.

features.title: Auto-count and reminders
features.text: Count automatically, remind me every X, and stop, vibrate or notify at the goal.

features.title: Rules and links
features.text: Rules read as sentences: "When Rest ends, add 1 to Sets". Drag one tile onto another.

features.title: Rule icons
features.text: Every tile shows whether rules watch it or change it.

features.title: Formulas
features.text: A read-only tile computed from your counters and timers.

features.title: Connected counts
features.text: Take a number from Health Connect or another app, instead of taps.

features.title: Widgets
features.text: Counter, Page and Timer home-screen widgets. Tap to count from the launcher.

features.title: Goals, repeats and streaks
features.text: Reach a goal every day, week or month and build a streak.

features.title: Share a result
features.text: A picture of your result, ready to post or send.

features.title: History and stats
features.text: Totals, 30-day average, best day, charts and every change by day.

features.title: Chart tiles
features.text: A bar or line chart of one counter on any page.

features.title: CSV export
features.text: One counter or everything, dice rolls included.

features.title: Dice and coin
features.text: d4 to d100, 1 to 20 at a time, with a modifier, or a coin.

features.title: Roll history
features.text: Past rolls, newest first. Undone rolls drop out.

features.title: Dice rules
features.text: "When Damage is rolled, subtract the result from HP".

features.title: Round tracker
features.text: Round number and turn order on one tile, up to 20 names.

features.title: Table mode
features.text: Lay the phone on the table: one zone per player, each facing them.

features.title: Settings
features.text: Theme, language, the day your week starts, and the alert beep.

features.title: 20 languages
features.text: Follows your device. Translations are early drafts.

apps.name: memoriz
apps.line: Learn and train a memory system.
apps.about: Build a person-action-object system for numbers, then drill it with palaces, levels and timed events.

features.title: The path
features.text: Where you are and the next step. One button starts today's work and says how big it is.

features.title: Learn or practise
features.text: Let the app pick today's work, or pick what, which numbers and how.

features.title: First steps
features.text: A short guided start: learn a code, get a PAO, learn it, get fast.

features.title: Spaced review
features.text: Reviews are scheduled with FSRS-6, so you see each number when it is due.

features.title: Speed work
features.text: Once you know a number, train how fast you recall it.

features.title: Scenes
features.text: Turn numbers into a scene you can picture.

features.title: Your palaces
features.text: Your memory palaces, open from day one.

features.title: Routes
features.text: Build new routes through a place you know.

features.title: Walks
features.text: Walk a palace to fix it in place.

features.title: Six drills
features.text: Numbers, images, names and faces, cards, dates and words.

features.title: Levels
features.text: Levels to pass, each with a clear next target.

features.title: Custom runs
features.text: Your own count, times and groups.

features.title: Competition formats
features.text: Timed formats, and any run can use a palace.

features.title: Timed events
features.text: Memorize, recall, and see exactly what you got wrong.

features.title: Level up
features.text: Results that show how far you have come.

features.title: The encoder
features.text: Encode real numbers: phones, plates, dates.

features.title: Your PAOs
features.text: Major, Dominic and other encodings. Your own entries in any language.

features.title: The 00-99 map
features.text: Every number at a glance, with how well you know it.

features.title: Guided builder
features.text: Build your system a step at a time.

features.title: Import
features.text: Paste text or CSV and review before it goes in.

features.title: Level, streaks, bests
features.text: Your level and your best runs in one place.

features.title: Share cards
features.text: A card of your result to share.

features.title: Number pings
features.text: Notifications that ask you to remember a number and recall it later.

features.title: Backup and settings
features.text: Back up, restore and set it up your way.

apps.name: lov

features.title: Last time
features.text: See how your pacts and your last good time went.

features.title: Check-in
features.text: How connected do you feel? Each picks 1 to 5.

features.title: Grateful
features.text: Thank each other, and say what you're grateful for in life.

features.title: Unspoken
features.text: Say what went unsaid, starting with "I felt", never "you did".

features.title: Words for feelings
features.text: Find the feeling, then what you need, with a live sentence to say aloud.

features.title: Repair
features.text: A way to say sorry, and reply ideas for the one listening.

features.title: Pact
features.text: Up to 3 small pacts: "After I ___, I will ___".

features.title: Feeling loved
features.text: "What can I do to make you feel more loved?" Small acts, not money.

features.title: Good time
features.text: Plan one good time before the next retro: light, nice or big.

features.title: Ask me anything
features.text: Draw a question: fun, deep, dreams, memories, now or silly.

features.title: Close
features.text: Did you feel heard? Then a hug and the date of the next retro.

features.title: Home
features.text: The next retro, open pacts and what makes each of you feel loved.

features.title: Take turns
features.text: One talks, one listens. Swap any time.

features.title: Resume
features.text: Pick up an unfinished retro where you left it.

features.title: Reminder
features.text: One gentle reminder on retro day.

features.title: Settings
features.text: Names, how often, reminder time and language.

features.title: Help
features.text: lov-ed isn't therapy. Where to turn when a topic keeps hurting.

features.title: Our story
features.text: What a retro is, and why we made lov-ed.

apps.about: Every few weeks, sit together with one phone and take turns: thanks, what went unsaid, sorry, small pacts and questions.
